summary.text: David Anderson is a Democratic candidate for Washington State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against fellow Democrat Sharlett Mena.
Ballotpedia lists him as a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Anderson graduated from Kentwood High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked at Costco for 11 years, starting by pushing carts and finishing as a refund clerk, and then opened a ninja warrior gym during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Anderson advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary in second place, with 26.9 percent of the vote to Mena's 73.1 percent.
In the survey, he listed balancing the budget, addressing homelessness through treatment, mental health professionals and outreach, and improving infrastructure as his goals.
